prior_information: Operator audit correlations and magnitudes known; these fixed selector outcomes have not been computed for this investigation.
bank: development only; original order, all 128 states, 9 actions each, 2 batches, times0/25/50/75; no fitting or confirmation arrays decoded

methods.q1: Cached audited development.q_current[:,0], converted float32 to float64; no new forward.
methods.twin_min: min of the two cached audited current Q heads after exact float64 conversion.
methods.actor: Original frozen actor candidate index0; verify actions[9*g] exactly equals saved_actor_actions[g]. No score optimization.
methods.mean_native_target: Arithmetic mean in float64 over the four cached native_y float32 draws in recorded order, converted before mean. No recomputation, draw choice, fitting, or smoothing resampling.

penalty_scope: Original BCA score remains Q1-kappa*U with live action gradient in actor objective; these four controls isolate operator relationship. No BCA coefficient, method, critic prediction, critic target or training configuration is changed. Native target is privileged evaluator-derived information, not a deployable score.

selection_ties.rule: Choose lowest original candidate index among abs(score-max(score)) <= atol+rtol*abs(max(score)). Preserve exact argmax, all near-max indices, ambiguity and top-two score gap. No recentering and no V-based tie break.

value_ties.rule: epsilon(method,control)=atol+rtol*max(abs(V_method),abs(V_control)); improve if delta>epsilon, harm if delta<-epsilon; otherwise numerically inconclusive.

primary_comparison: mean_native_target vs q1; mean paired saved-V gain separately in each development batch.
stopping_screen: PASS only if mean(V_mean_native_target-V_q1)>mean(epsilon(mean_native_target,q1)) in BOTH batches. Numerical exploratory direction screen, not a confidence bound or scientific superiority claim. If either fails STOP this operator-replacement branch; no threshold/draw/control changes or serial diagnostic expansion.
controls: twin_min and actor are descriptive fixed controls; do not promote best control or use them to replace primary screen.
outcomes: mean paired gain vs q1 and actor
selected action index and all scores per state
aggregation: Equal-state descriptive means; no bootstrap/CI/significance claims, independent-action inflation, outcome filters or favorable strata selection.
